title: Beautiful and good quality.
text: Beautiful and good quality.. These are nice and big and I love that! They are not the yucky "velour" type that dont absorb anything.  They are a good quality cotton, and not too thick, in a good way. The printing on the towels are very clear with no spreading issues. I am very impressed with them
